title: Cross-Domain Violation: Fulfillment Worker Attempts Payment
invariantSummary: Least-Privilege Context Invariant: An agent operating under domain 'fulfillment' has zero access to checkout/payment mutations. Proposing checkout mutation 'submitPayment' violates formal domain boundaries and is rejected mathematically with DOMAIN_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION.

expectedVerdictDetails.feedback: DOMAIN_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION: The agent operating under 'fulfillment' least-privilege context attempted to execute 'submitPayment', which belongs to domain 'checkout'.
